stage.name: Twin Gargoyles
stage.description:
Give people a path, and they'll fight tooth and nail to follow it. Deny them one, and they'll carve a path themselves.
Choose a foe and fight. Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants better reward
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

street_drunk.name: 'Street Drunk'
street_drunk.flavourText: Armed militants disguised as Infected, they are overly acquainted with the local situation, to the point that they have become alcoholics hanging around the street pubs, their mission long forgotten.
abilities: When attacking targets outside of Realigned Flux, deals a certain percentage of Arts damage

alcohol_association_member.name: Alcohol Association Member
alcohol_association_member.flavourText: A piss-drunk Durin. 'I'm not drunk! Who said I was drunk? Was it you?!'
abilities: Initially has 100% Physical Dodge for a period of time

ergate_leader.name: Ergate Leader
ergate_leader.flavourText: An engineer that specializes in sabotage, almost never seen wielding weapons. Though unarmed, they utilize their agility and cunning to slip through defenses in order to sabotage mechanical and electrical equipment. They are more difficult to deal with than normal Ergates.
abilities: Cannot be blocked.

guerrilla_herald_leader.name: Guerrilla Herald Leader
guerrilla_herald_leader.flavourText: Compared to regular heralds, these leaders have greater individual combat capabilities. The heralds are important links within their communication system. While present, they will issue tactical commands to increase the offensive and defensive abilities of nearby allies.
abilities: Increases the ATK and DEF of enemy units when on the battlefield.

keratex_clawbeast.name: Keratex Clawbeast
keratex_clawbeast.flavourText: A Chitotex Clawbeast subspecies particular to certain regions. Their sturdy upper limbs accelerate their excavation of rock exponentially, while their stern shells can shrug off severe batterings. These traits allow them to better expand their territory.
abilities: Weak spot located on its front, damage dealt to the rear is significantly decreased

lakeside_lifeguard.name: Lakeside Lifeguard
lakeside_lifeguard.flavourText: A professional lifeguard who goes around shooting the breeze. Strong in stature and bronzed in complexion, one look at him is enough to give a sense of security. But in actuality, he can't swim at all, and got that tan from high-intensity outdoor boxing training.
abilities: Upon dropping below half HP for the first time, gains 100% Physical Dodge for a period of time

mortar_gunner_leader.name: Mortar Gunner Leader
mortar_gunner_leader.flavourText: One of Reunion's special ranged soldiers, more dangerous than a normal Mortar Gunner. Equipped with pilfered military-grade Originium launchers, they launch explosive attacks from hard-to-defend positions, making them a significant threat to back-line Operators.
abilities: Capable of extremely long ranged-attacks
Shells deal area damage to target and any allied units in the surrounding 8 tiles

sniper_leader.name: Sniper Leader
sniper_leader.flavourText: A basic ranged soldier. They are stronger than normal Snipers, firing improved ammunition that stuns for a longer duration. Proceed with caution.
abilities: After two attacks, the next attack Stuns its target

ursus_civilian.name: Ursus Civilian
ursus_civilian.flavourText: An ordinary Ursus citizen caught in the crossfire. A part of the cruelty and suffering of this world.
abilities: Does not deplete Life Points when spared, but will deplete a Life Point upon dying
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter

invisible_caster.name: Invisible Caster
invisible_caster.flavourText: One of Reunion's Casters. The ghillie suit they wear makes it almost impossible to detect them before they engage in combat. Therefore, teamwork is needed to defeat them.
abilities: Invisible

lurker.name: Lurker
lurker.flavourText: One of Reunion's special soldiers. They move swiftly and stealthily, making it almost impossible to detect them before they engage in combat. Therefore, teamwork is needed in order to defeat them.
abilities: Invisible

brassrust_olmer_ingra.name: 'Brassrust' Olmer Ingra
brassrust_olmer_ingra.flavourText: The great knight known as the 'Butcher of the Field'! Convicted several times for acts of brutality, avoided trial several times thanks to corporate contributions! Youngest son of the Ingra family, an ancient knightly lineage! A ruthless fighter who gets stronger with each battle! Olmerrrrrr Ingraaaaaaa!
abilities: Each time an enemy is defeated, gains ATK and ASPD, stacking up to 10 times.

left_hand_tytus_topola.name: 'Left-hand' Tytus Topola
left_hand_tytus_topola.flavourText: His nose is high as the sun, and he's almost as terrifyingly strong, if much, much colder. And look how many fans have lined up for him! He's 'Left-hand' Tytus Topola! He weakens his enemies' resolve, crushes their spirit, sneering down at them as they fall to their knees in surrender. That's a Left-handed victory!
abilities: Significantly decreases ATK of the unit with the highest ATK for a period of time
Rebirth

competitive_grade_beach_buggy.name: Competitive-Grade Beach Buggy
competitive_grade_beach_buggy.flavourText: A beach buggy beloved by all. Though its capacity is the same, all its other peripherals have been upgraded - in particular, the AC unit that effortlessly makes driver and passengers alike shiver.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
When next to enemies that are both non-Machine and non-Leader, they will be loaded inside as passengers (up to 3 max), and will be unloaded when this unit is defeated

dublinn_elite_companion_guard.name: Dublinn Elite Companion Guard
dublinn_elite_companion_guard.flavourText: A member of the Dublinn forces' elite operations squad, they are much stronger than regular squad members. The shields they wield are the culmination of many nations' technologies, providing cover for their partners while advancing, and protecting all nearby allies from harm.
abilities: More likely to get attacked by your units
When a <Dublinn Elite Companion Shadowblade> is nearby, activates a field that reduces nearby allied units' ASPD
Refraction

dublinn_elite_companion_shadowblade.name: Dublinn Elite Companion Shadowblade
dublinn_elite_companion_shadowblade.flavourText: A member of the Dublinn forces' elite operations squad, they are much stronger than regular squad members. When they move alongside their partners, they gain powerful stealth capabilities and their attacks are much swifter.
abilities: Invisible
When a <Dublinn Elite Companion Guard> is nearby, significantly increases ASPD

duck_lord.name: Duck Lord
duck_lord.flavourText: A famous Columbian investor, entrepreneur, and master of 'Duck Power.' Out of the public eye, enjoys kicking back with others...
abilities: Cannot be blocked.
Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after being attacked

elite_imperial_striker.name: Elite Imperial Striker
elite_imperial_striker.flavourText: The powerful, battle-tested infantry of the Ursus Army, the backbone of the Imperial Army's aggressive advance. They are versatile in offense and defense, melee and ranged. After sustain a certain amount of damage, their morale will peak, causing them to inflict more destruction. Along with the Shieldguards, they formed the front line of the Ursus Army.
abilities: Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%

elite_pugilist_prisoner.name: Elite Pugilist Prisoner
elite_pugilist_prisoner.flavourText: An inmate who wholeheartedly trusts in his fists. Do not underestimate this inmate who is able to utilize both fist and chain in harmony now.
abilities: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK and attacks ignore a certain portion of the target's DEF

enhanced_mass_produced_colossus.name: Enhanced Mass-Produced Colossus
enhanced_mass_produced_colossus.flavourText: An Originium Arts creation that sacrifices stability for miniaturization. Very well-equipped for breaching, it is often used to break through enemy lines. Its physical strength has been improved but its weakness to interference remains an issue.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
When in Realigned Flux, DEF and RES are greatly reduced

enraged_possessed_bonethrower.name: Enraged Possessed Bonethrower
enraged_possessed_bonethrower.flavourText: An enemy ranged combatant who has completely given in to primal madness as their lifeforce is consumed. The infection has penetrated their bone marrow, they will even rip out the Originium lodged inside their bodies to throw because of their deadened sense of pain. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.
abilities: Will gradually lose HP over time

enraged_possessed_leader.name: Enraged Possessed Leader
enraged_possessed_leader.flavourText: An enemy combatant who has completely given in to primal madness as their lifeforce is consumed. The infection has penetrated their bone marrow, and their death-defying aggression breaks the bounds of reason. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.
abilities: Will gradually lose HP over time

enraged_tombkeeper_grotesque.name: Enraged Tombkeeper Grotesque
enraged_tombkeeper_grotesque.flavourText: A special Arts creation from the Dublinn forces, created by their leader Mandragora. According to Mandragora, back when she was studying Originium Arts in an outskirts cemetery, the Tombkeeper Grotesque was her first companion. Its outer appearance has gone through many redesigns, with the latest being based off a Sarkaz from an ancient bloodline. This series of Tombkeepers embodies Mandragora's fury towards Victoria.
abilities: After first defeat, temporarily transforms into a stone statue with extremely high DEF, then revives as an aerial unit
Refraction

famiglia_luxury_limo.name: Famiglia Luxury Limo
famiglia_luxury_limo.flavourText: A lesser-seen vehicle among the famiglie, sporting an unassuming exterior but a luxurious interior. Generally, these are only used to welcome the most distinguished of the famiglia's guests, and to convey to them the graces of the famiglia's high-ranking members.
abilities: Unloads 3 <Elite Famiglia Soldiers> if this is unit is defeated while blocked

gopnik.name: Gopnik
gopnik.flavourText: The Ursus security guard hired by Duck Lord. Powerful, but not very smart. Mainly responsible for carrying luggage for Duck Lord.

greytail_leader.name: Greytail Leader
greytail_leader.flavourText: The Rat King's elite guard, granted special Originium Arts by the Rat King, allowing him to create a Barrier to protect himself. Movement speed is increased when the Barrier is broken. Stronger in combat than a Greytail.
abilities: DEF significantly increases when the Barrier is present.
Movement Speed significantly increases when the Barrier is destroyed.

hateful_avenger_enemy_1025_reveng_2.name: Hateful Avenger
hateful_avenger_enemy_1025_reveng_2.flavourText: An unidentified combatant who attacks using unconventional methods, more dangerous than a normal Avenger. Equipped with a special weapon, they are known to change their attack patterns during combat, making them difficult to defend against. Proceed with caution.
abilities: Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%

heavy_defender_lieutenant.name: Heavy Defender Lieutenant
heavy_defender_lieutenant.flavourText: One of Reunion's melee soldiers, more dangerous than a Heavy Defender Leader. Equipped with a full set of heavy armor, they usually appear alongside a large number of troops and are extremely hard to defeat. Proceed with caution.

kouaku_cautelotaur.name: Kouaku Cautelotaur
kouaku_cautelotaur.flavourText: A cunning and ruthless variety of Cautelotaur, it conceals itself in herds to launch surprise attacks, the prey it catches subjected to its capricious whims. Most hunters that attempt to hunt this creature return with nothing to show for it.
abilities: After feeding on a <Chitotex Clawbeast> or <Keratex Clawbeast>, keeps its shell to use as a defensive tool, significantly lowering all damage except to the rear

lazurite_monique.name: Lazurite, Monique
lazurite_monique.flavourText: A Lazurite of the Armorless Union, Monique. She has a habit of recording her own condition in great detail before operations. She hates Roy and anyone who interrupts her work.
abilities: Every attack deals Corrosion
After several attacks, the next attack deals more damage

lazurite_roy.name: Lazurite, Roy
lazurite_roy.flavourText: A Lazurite of the Armorless Union, Roy. No one knows how a killer managed to achieve such a position and hold it for so many years. Rumor says that his wealth has already surpassed the CEOs of some small companies, while his power exceeds many competition knights.
abilities: Every attack deals Corrosion
After several attacks, the next attack deals more damage

lost_contraption.name: Lost Contraption
lost_contraption.flavourText: An automated thought collector built by a lost Kazdelian empire. It has continuously operated for so long that its movements have become slow and haphazard.
abilities: Steals Originium Ingots upon entering the Objective.

lost_hovercraft.name: Lost Hovercraft
lost_hovercraft.flavourText: An automated thought collector built by a lost Kazdelian empire. Despite its ability to hover for extended periods, its built-in package protection mechanism compels it to land immediately upon encountering interference.
abilities: Low-Altitude Hovering
Steals Originium Ingots upon entering the Objective.

r_11a_assault_power_armor.name: R-11a Assault Power Armor
r_11a_assault_power_armor.flavourText: A model equipped with long-ranged weapons, massively increasing its offensive capabilities. It's difficult to imagine what sort of changes might come about if this tech could be mass-produced.
abilities: Attacks 4 enemies simultaneously

r_31a_heavy_power_armor.name: R-31a Heavy Power Armor
r_31a_heavy_power_armor.flavourText: A model that appeared around half a year ago among some mercenary groups, its performance is on par with mass-produced military models from five years ago. Technology is unregulated, so Columbians continue to seek greater efficiency within the bounds of the law.
abilities: [Overload] Continuously deals Physical damage to the target proportional to the unit's ATK, andStuns the target

raging_direswine.name: Raging Direswine
raging_direswine.flavourText: A variety of Direswine extremely easy to anger, they dominate areas near water sources with great swagger. If one is enraged, it will indiscriminately rampage about with a madness sufficient to lay anything in the vicinity low.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
Gradually accelerates when charging, dealing damage based on Movement Speed to any target it passes through or is blocked by

sarkaz_crossbowman_leader.name: Sarkaz Crossbowman Leader
sarkaz_crossbowman_leader.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz, more dangerous than a normal Sarkaz Sniper. Their towering physique has not hampered their marksmanship. On the contrary, it allows them to use larger ranged weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

sarkaz_greatswordsman_leader.name: Sarkaz Greatswordsman Leader
sarkaz_greatswordsman_leader.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz, more dangerous than a normal Sarkaz Swordsman. The Originium inside them has boosted their physical abilities, allowing them to wield larger weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

sarkaz_guerrilla_fighter_leader.name: Sarkaz Guerrilla Fighter Leader
sarkaz_guerrilla_fighter_leader.flavourText: A Sarkaz fighter who boasts greater destructive power, but cannot understand the special terminology of their guerilla operations. The Sarkaz ritual maintained by the Sarkaz Originium Altars will not damage them, instead strengthening their bodies and converting their attacks into Arts damage.
abilities: When coming into contact with a Pulse Wave, this unit instead takes no damage and will deal Arts damage with normal attacks.

sarkaz_lancer_leader.name: Sarkaz Lancer Leader
sarkaz_lancer_leader.flavourText: A Sarkaz, more threatening than a normal Sarkaz Lancer. After special training, they are capable of rushing forward with a long spear, building up speed. The faster they charge, the harder they strike anyone who might stand in their way.
abilities: Gradually accelerates when moving, and deals additional damage on the first attack after being blocked based upon Movement Speed.

shanhaizhong_oracle.name: Shanhaizhong Oracle
shanhaizhong_oracle.flavourText: Shanhaizhong members who can cast strange Arts. They superstitiously believe in those huge beings and resent their own compatriots, shouting 'the mounts, seas, and all in between shall be our master's' while displaying a 'divine power' of unknown origin.
abilities: Continuously locks on to a target and inflicts a large burst of Arts damage after the channel completes, gaining increased ASPD afterwards

shanhaizhong_secret_keeper.name: Shanhaizhong Secret-Keeper
shanhaizhong_secret_keeper.flavourText: A Shanhaizhong leader with a mysterious mission. Elusive, merciless, and unconcerned with their men's sacrifices. What are they really planning behind that fog of faith?
abilities: Invisible
The next attack made after breaking Invisibility will deal increased damage

test_power_armor.name: Test Power Armor
test_power_armor.flavourText: An unpiloted Power Armor. It seems to have a mind of its own, and even experienced engineers struggle to tell if it's being piloted.

yeti_icecleaver_leader.name: Yeti Icecleaver Leader
yeti_icecleaver_leader.flavourText: A special melee combatant of the Yeti Squadron hailing from teams of infected gerilla warriors in the Northwestern Tundra. Experienced executioners on the battlefield, they wield long katanas that can easily ravage frozen Operators, and their nickname, 'Ice Cleaver,' references their devastating blows that seem strong enough to split glaciers.
abilities: Attack power increases greatly when attacking Frozen targets

frost_buck.name: 'Frost Buck'
frost_buck.flavourText: An actor playing the role of the Sami Snowpriest's bodyguard, 'Frost Buck'. After countless performances, they have fallen completely into their role, and wish for their demise at the hands of a foe as scary as the 'Demons'.
abilities: Attack power increases greatly when attacking Frozen targets
When <'Snow Doe'> dies, greatly increases ASPD and Movement Speed, and inherits its ability

rat_king.name: 'Rat King'
rat_king.flavourText: Lin, Lin Gray, the Rat King of the slum. He bears many titles, just like the shifting of the city's shadows underneath his feet. Don't touch the red lines. If you ever have a moment of indecisiveness, whatever it is that you were concerned about will become nothing more than a whisper in the winds above the dunes.
abilities: [Singing Sands] Targets a unit with the highest Max HP, dealing heavy physical damage to the target and nearby allied units within a cross area
[Sand Tomb] Targets a unit with the lowest Max HP, continuously inflicting Arts damage to the target and nearby allies, also reducing their ATK
Appears with a Barrier that can absorb a large amount of Arts damage, gains significantly increased DEF while Barrier is active
Deals more damage when HP drops below half

snow_doe.name: 'Snow Doe'
snow_doe.flavourText: An actor playing the role of the Sami Snowpriest's bodyguard, 'Snow Doe'. After countless performances, they have fallen completely into their role, and wish for their demise at the hands of a foe as twisted as the 'Frozen Monstrosity'.
abilities: Attacks inflict Cold
When <'Frost Buck'> dies, greatly increases ASPD and Movement Speed, and inherits its ability

big_adam.name: Big Adam
big_adam.flavourText: One of Reunion's squad leaders. He wears a heavy blast suit and attacks with an electric chainsaw. Bears a remarkable similarity to Big Bob, but does not appear to be the same person. It is unknown whether there is any relationship between the two of them. Data suggests that he may be even more dangerous than Big Bob. Due to his devastating attacks and extreme survivability, proceed with utmost caution.

big_bob.name: Big Bob
big_bob.flavourText: One of Reunion's squad leaders. He wears a heavy blast suit and attacks with an electric chainsaw. He has been spotted leading peripheral operations in some remote areas, and is known to be a seasoned combatant and commander. Due to his devastating attacks and extreme survivability, proceed with utmost caution.

corrupted_knight.name: Corrupted Knight
corrupted_knight.flavourText: A Sarkaz knight with a broken horn who radiates terror and shows clear signs of excessive drug use. Uses a warhammer in battle. Crushes enemies with terrifying bloodlust. When the Withered Knight falls, takes up the quest and becomes dramatically stronger. Every step he takes spreads corruption.
abilities: Attacks deal Physical damage to the target and adjacent allied units
Does charged attacks, dealing heavy Physical damage to the targets and any adjacent units
Gains greatly increased ATK, ASPD, and Movement Speed when <Withered Knight> dies

crownslayer.name: Crownslayer
crownslayer.flavourText: One of Reunion's squad leaders who handles infiltration and assassination operations, specializing in melee combat and breaking through defensive lines. Her stealth and superb infiltration abilities have foiled countless attempts to capture her.
abilities: When blocked, can quickly move behind the unit

frostnova_winters_scar.name: FrostNova, 'Winter's Scar'
frostnova_winters_scar.flavourText: Leader of the Yeti Squadron, she has released the remainder of what little life force she has left in preparation for the final battle. The biting cold of the land has already been released; are we truly prepared to make an enemy out of it?
abilities: Normal attacks and Ice Nova deal Arts damage and applies Cold to targets
Ice Nova deals double damage to Frozen targets
Initially Invulnerable for a period of time during the second form, attacks and skills become stronger

jesselton_williams.name: Jesselton Williams
jesselton_williams.flavourText: Jesselton Williams, a killer who infiltrated the prison disguised as a jailer. Very particular in both speech and action, he remains graceful even in the midst of battle.
abilities: Jailer Form
RES is greatly increased
Attacks become ranged and deal Arts damage, and no longer attacks Imprisonment Devices
Can Stun multiple targets
The first time HP drops to 0, enters Killer Form
Killer Form
Frees all imprisoned enemies when entering Killer Form
Gains significantly increased DEF
Uses melee Physical attacks that ignore a certain amount of the target's DEF

saint_carmen.name: Saint Carmen
saint_carmen.flavourText: The last surviving Saint of Iberia, living well past mortal life expectancy. His longevity came at a price, but he remembers his duty and his enemies, despite having lost his reason.
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks become long-ranged and deal a large amount of Physical damage. Ammo capacity: 3
If reloading is interrupted, becomes Stunned for an additional period of time

saint_iberia.name: Saint Iberia
saint_iberia.flavourText: The last surviving Saint of Iberia, living well past mortal life expectancy. His longevity came at a price, but he will hunt Iberia's enemies for as long as the flame of his life still burns.
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks become long-ranged and deal a large amount of Physical damage. Ammo capacity: 1
If reloading is interrupted, becomes Stunned for an additional period of time
Has higher HP and ATK

tidelinked_archon.name: Tidelinked Archon
tidelinked_archon.flavourText: —Sea Terror. Even Ægir technology has a role to play in the evolution of we many.
abilities: Attacks inflict additional Corrosion.
When its Other Half is alive and not in coma, enters a coma when HP reaches 0 and begins regenerating; revives when HP reaches max.

tidelinked_bishop.name: Tidelinked Bishop
tidelinked_bishop.flavourText: A bishop that has partially mutated. It is partly human, partly—
abilities: When its Other Half is alive and not in coma, enters a coma when HP reaches 0 and begins regenerating; revives when HP reaches max.

withered_knight.name: Withered Knight
withered_knight.flavourText: A Sarkaz knight with a broken horn who radiates terror and shows clear signs of excessive drug use. Uses a cursed bow in battle. Can shoot multiple targets at once and plant seeds of withering arts. When the Corrupted Knight falls, takes up the quest and becomes dramatically stronger. Knights that are hostile to him will shift to Wither.
abilities: Attacks 2 targets simultaneously
Fires explosive arrows at three targets which explode after a short delay, dealing high Arts damage to the target and surrounding four tiles
Gains greatly increased ATK, ASPD, and Movement Speed when <Corrupted Knight> dies
